name: Meet Her There
source:
If you can return the things that already passed, would you do everything right?

Try, fail, try again to find the correct steps, in order to save the person you love.

[From [url=https://h-ak.itch.io/meet-her-there]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果能把已經過去的事重新來過，你就能把一切都做對嗎？

嘗試，失敗，再試一次。找到正確的步驟，救回你愛的人。

[摘自[url=https://h-ak.itch.io/meet-her-there]itch.io[/url]]
